name: Modern Prophets
overview: Scripture clearly distinguishes true prophets, who speak only the words God commands, from false prophets who presume to speak without divine authorization and lead people astray. God warns that any prophet who speaks in His name but whose predictions do not come to pass is not sent by Him and should not be feared. The Lord reveals His plans through His servants, the prophets, yet He is firmly against those who prophesy false dreams and cause His people to err. Believers are cautioned to beware of false prophets who appear harmless but are inwardly destructive, underscoring the necessity of discernment in evaluating modern prophetic claims.
